watches.title: A non-Treasury category breaks out
watches.rule: Any asset class other than Treasuries & MMFs above 5% of yield-bearing value, with at least 5× like-for-like growth since the first weekly snapshot.
watches.reading: Largest: Private & structured credit at 33.0% share, 1.08× like-for-like since 2026-05-15

watches.title: Ethereum's share drops below 70%
watches.rule: Ethereum's share of yield-bearing value read on-chain, chain by chain. Fires only once at least 90% of value is read this way, over 2+ weekly reads.
watches.reading: Not enough data yet: 12% of value read on-chain over 1 read(s); needs 90% over 2.

watches.title: An anchor issuer halves
watches.rule: Any of the 10 largest issuers down 50% or more, like-for-like (same assets, same source) against any earlier weekly snapshot covering at least 80% of its value.
watches.reading: No anchor issuer is down 50%+ like-for-like
